text: Two buttons. You can only press one.
Button A: one million dollars. Today.
Button B: one thousand dollars, every week, for the rest of your life.
B pays fifty-two thousand a year.
In about nineteen years, it passes A.
Live sixty more years? B pays over three million.
Park A's million somewhere earning five percent, and it pays you fifty thousand a year.
And you still keep the million.
With three percent inflation, in thirty years, your thousand buys what four hundred twelve does today.
Then rewatch. You might change your mind.
